parole.significato: A collection of stray ice crystals that form in fast-moving water.
parole.testo: From Canadian French frasil, frazil, fraisil, from French fraisil (“coal cinders”), from Old French faisil.

parole.significato: A form of stiff leather made from rawhide.
parole.testo: From Canadian French parflèche, equivalent to French par(er) (“to parry”) + French flèche (“arrow”).
From Canadian French, from French poilu (“hairy”). Doublet of poilu.

parole.significato: A type of traditional French-Canadian meat pie, usually made with pork.
parole.testo: From Canadian French tourtière, from a cooking vessel of the same name, from French tourte (“meat pie”). There is a common false etymology that it derives from the alternative meaning tourte (“passenger pigeon”).
